Get a free 15-day trial of Odoo’s all-in-one business solution and see how it can make your life easier! Check it out at https://www.odoo.com/ltt

Sony really made an official Linux kit for the PlayStation 2, and somehow we got our hands on one 24 years later. The only problem is we’re missing some pretty important hardware, the discs are in Japanese, and getting this thing running is anything but straightforward. So naturally, we’re going to try anyway and see what Linux on a PS2 was actually like in 2002.
